review.why: Hands a question to a background agent that cites primary sources into a Markdown note in the repository.
review.summary: A very short skill: start a background agent with a fresh context to investigate a question against primary sources (official docs, source code, specs, first-party APIs), write the findings with a source for each claim to one Markdown file, and save it where the repository already keeps such notes.
strengths: Insists on primary sources and following each claim back to its owner
Saves the result in the repository, matching its conventions
cautions: Very short: no method to plan, verify or handle conflicting sources
Assumes the runtime can start a background agent
Aimed at developer documentation and API facts
